description: 200 seeded scenarios with absences of 1 minute to 2 hours (first session 20-90 minutes, POL5-BAL with one of four offline plans, 1-8 storage batches): the reference stepper (full log hashing, uncached stats, the reference bounded ledger, one straight run) against the efficient settlement through the service (each batch a validated save and restore), and a reference checkpoint restored into the efficient engine (reconstruction). Exact state agreement required; no sampled batching is used.
